correctness.rationale: The even octavic is g(x²) with g=(z²−az+1)(z²−bz+1), a+b=−u, ab=v−2. The factors are squarefree and disjoint exactly when (a²−4)(b²−4)(a−b)≠0, equivalent to the displayed open set. The quadratics’ resultant is (a−b)², also yielding the stated discriminant. The Cartier–Manin coefficient matrix and prime-field eigenbasis are correct; semilinear iterates preserve exactly the nonzero diagonal slots, and the a-number is the first Cartier corank. Count the three indexed slots, with repetition, as specified by the table and proof, not distinct scalar values. The conic’s homogenization is nonsingular; the two graphs are smooth; restriction of the conic to either graph has one excluded triple root and one allowed simple root. With the intersection of the graphs this gives exactly the stated three transverse intersections, no triple point, and the reduced SNC divisor of the determinant. /workspace/review_replay.py independently checks the coefficient matrix in the eigenbasis, the quadratic resultant, the elimination identities and transversality; no finite census is used to establish the geometric claim.
